title: steenisia borneensis
intro: Steenisia borneensis, commonly known as the Borneo Steenisia, is a plant species within the family Rubiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include the potential to reduce inflammation and improve antioxidant activity, thus contributing to its use in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Steenisia borneensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
